newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones rose 38.44 points to 6,346.77. PLDT's ADR was unchanged at $57 1/2.
* On Wednesday, the peso closed steady at 26.289 to a U.S. dollar.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,105.80, up 12.59.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was at 10.875 from 10.90625 pct.

* The newspaper BusinessWorld said the Securities and Exchange Commission has suspended indefinitely the trading of Centennial City shares due to possible violation of disclosure rules and the conditions for the approval of the increase in its capital stock.
* BusinessWorld said Benpres Holdings Corp has formed a new company with its French partner Lyonnaise Des Eaux to bid for the privatisation of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System.
* The Manila Bulletin said the House of Representatives ratified last night a bicameral conference committee report proposing amendments to the expanded value-added tax.

* The Business Daily said Malaysian firm Leisure Management Berhad had completed payment of Philippine Racing Club Inc (PRCI) shares acquired from Philippine Realty and Holdings Corp, PRCI chairman Edgardo Espiritu said.

* The Manila Times said the Social Weather Stations' 10-year monitoring of the state of the judiciary and legal profession in the country showed the public's perception of judges, lawyers and court personnel has reached "critical" and "alarming" levels.

* The Philippine Star said government's economic planners, the inter-agency Development and Budget Coordination Committee, is maintaining its projections of at least seven percent growth in gross domestic product (GDP) in the next two years.
